reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Refactor to not use global logger in modules 11051", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: The changelog entry describes only an internal code refactoring (Loki modules no longer use a global logger) and states no operator-facing configuration or behavioral change, so an upgrading environment has no stated operational consequence.

proposed.statement: The Loki 3.0.0 changelog lists an internal refactor (PR 11051) so that modules no longer use a global logger; no operator-facing configuration surface or behavioral effect is stated.
